nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the token name, set in the constructor to SHIBAMARS.
Public string state variable holding the token symbol, set in the constructor to SHIBAMARS.
Public uint8 state variable holding token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Public uint256 state variable holding the total token supply, set to 100000000000000000000000000000000 in the constructor.
Mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances of every account.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) tracking ERC20 allowances.
Constructor that initializes name, symbol, decimals and _totalSupply, and credits the entire supply to msg.sender.
Public view returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
Public view returning the balance of a given tokenOwner address.
Public view returning the remaining allowance a spender has over a tokenOwner's tokens.
Public function setting allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emitting Approval.
Public function transferring tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub and safeAdd.
Public function moving tokens from one address to another using the caller's allowance without any explicit allowance check.
SafeMath helper performing a + b with an overflow require check.
SafeMath helper performing a - b with a require(b <= a) underflow check.
SafeMath helper performing a * b with a require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow check.
SafeMath helper performing a / b with a require(b > 0) division-by-zero check.
Caller-controlled address used as the owner of balances and allowances in the constructor, approve, transfer and transferFrom.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply(), which can underflow and revert if address(0) ever holds a balance.
Debit of balances[msg.sender] by tokens via safeSub inside transfer().
Debit of balances[from] by tokens via safeSub inside transferFrom() without verifying that the spender is authorised for that amount beyond the SafeMath revert.
Debit of allowed[from][msg.sender] by tokens via safeSub inside transferFrom(); the missing explicit allowance require makes the authorisation logic implicit.
Unconditional write of allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens inside approve().

edges.reason: msg.sender is credited with the entire initial supply in the constructor.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in approve().
msg.sender is used to select the source balance in transfer().
msg.sender is used as the spender key in transferFrom().
msg.sender flows into the debit of balances[msg.sender] inside transfer().
msg.sender flows into the allowance key debited in transferFrom().
msg.sender flows into the allowance storage write in approve().
Constructor assigns the name state variable.
Constructor assigns the symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns the decimals state variable.
Constructor assigns the _totalSupply state variable.
Constructor writes the initial balance into the balances mapping.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply() reads balances[address(0)].
totalSupply() performs the unchecked subtraction represented by this unsafe operation.
_totalSupply is the left operand of the unchecked subtraction.
balances[address(0)] is the right operand of the unchecked subtraction that may underflow.
transfer() executes the safeSub-based balance debit.
The balances mapping is read and written by the debit in transfer().
The tokens parameter is the subtracted amount in transfer().
transferFrom() executes the safeSub-based debit of the from balance.
The balances mapping is read and written by the debit in transferFrom().
The from parameter selects the balance debited in transferFrom().
The tokens parameter is the subtracted amount in transferFrom().
transferFrom() debits the allowance with safeSub without any explicit require(allowance >= tokens) check.
The allowed mapping is read and decremented by transferFrom().
The from parameter selects the allowance owner key in transferFrom().
The tokens parameter is the subtracted allowance amount in transferFrom().
approve() unconditionally overwrites the allowance storage slot.
The allowed mapping is written by approve().
The spender parameter is the allowance key written in approve().
The tokens parameter is the allowance value written in approve().
transfer() calls safeSub to subtract tokens from the sender balance.
transfer() calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom() calls safeSub to subtract tokens from balances and allowance.
transferFrom() calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
